analyst_view.overall: Early view: FC Utrecht come out of the break in crisis after losing 4-2 at Telstar and 3-2 at home to NEC, with Anthony Correia admitting set pieces and the defence are a problem. Cambuur's Johan Plat was October's Coach of the Month, but shipped five at home to PSV and, by one report, have lost captain Amofa for the season.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.2 goals, already a very high figure. Utrecht have conceded seven in two games and Cambuur let in five against PSV, so the goals case is real, but Correia has spent the break drilling his defence. I stay with the number rather than push it higher.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, mostly Utrecht's. A home side needing a win should push Cambuur back, which fits the split, and nothing I read points to a change in either team's approach.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards. I lean a touch higher: Utrecht are 14th and under real pressure, Correia talked of cracking the whip, and frustrated home sides that fall behind tend to collect bookings. Cambuur's crowd trouble at the PSV game also shows the club's matches can get heated.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.1 shots. Utrecht's 17.5 fits a home side forced to attack, and Cambuur created enough to score twice even against PSV, so I agree with the total.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target. Both defences are leaking, which supports the estimate, but neither attack has been especially sharp outside their best days, so I do not move it.
